target.name: R Draconis
target.notes: Mira-type pulsating red giant variable near the North Ecliptic Pole (SPHEREx Deep Field). Saturates detector cores (NaN in core, OVERFLOW flag in halo) and has nearly continuous cadence in spherex_dr1_deep and spherex_qr3_deep.

scientific_warnings: 180-degree spacecraft roll (SPS_EPA) flip detected across survey passes; all frames have been WCS-reprojected onto a common North-up, East-left TAN grid.

SPHEREx Linear Variable Filters sample a different wavelength per exposure. Compare brightness strictly within the same detector band to distinguish true variability from the star's spectral energy distribution (SED).
Detector core saturation (OVERFLOW / NaN core) detected in 47/47 frames. Visual cores are reconstructed from the 98th-percentile PSF halo; astrometric centroids use halo center-of-mass.
1 frame(s) were dropped or excluded during processing (low_valid_pixel_fraction: level2_2026W19_1A_0930_3D6_spx_l2b-v27-2026-245).
